name: Oregon
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (DAS/EIS guidance implementing the ADA Title II rule)

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: Federal Rule: Accessibility of Web Information and Services — FAQ (DAS, 2025-02-24)
2024 Guidance on Accessibility for E-Government Program Services v1.2

applies_to: Executive Branch boards, commissions and agencies, and contractors providing public services for them. Local governments are covered only by the ADA Title II floor.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Review public websites, mobile apps and content for WCAG 2.1 AA and fix gaps
Build compliance reviews into business processes and workflows
Use E-Gov (Tyler Oregon) templates and Siteimprove testing for oregon.gov sites
mobile: explicit — the EIS page and FAQ name mobile applications.
procurement: Contractors providing covered services must meet the same standard; no separate state VPAT mandate found.
enforcement: No state-specific complaint mechanism found; agencies are told to consult Oregon DOJ counsel. ADA Title II complaints go to US DOJ.
notes: Oregon relies on DAS/EIS guidance, not a state statute. The Feb 2025 FAQ still says 2026-04-24; the EIS page reflects the 2027-04-26 extension.
